forensic_architecture.existing_source_infrastructure: Binance USD-M 1h REST/archive materializers validate 12-field klines and close timestamps, but no prospective JH01 source contract is yet qualified.
forensic_architecture.existing_persistence_infrastructure: RemoteGitClaim creates a GitHub remote ref atomically across worktrees/clones and has local crash/replay tests.
forensic_architecture.reused_existing_primitive: REMOTE_GIT_REF_PLUS_O_EXCL_RECEIPT was assessed only as an at-most-once claim primitive.
forensic_architecture.new_infrastructure_required: A qualified append-only persistence backend with server-observed immutable receipt time, explicit retention, and read-after-unknown-write evidence is required before implementation authorization.

persistence_backend_qualification.rejection: Git commit author/committer timestamps and local receipts are caller-controlled; remote ref creation alone does not provide a server-observed, non-backdateable persistence time.

frozen_later_implementation_contract.activation_precondition: A separate Git-backed governance phase must qualify a persistence backend with every required property YES before any recorder implementation is authorized.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.source_finality_rule: UTC Binance USD-M 1h klines only; each required ordered panel symbol has exactly one 12-field bar for every required close, interval=1h, close_time is the source close timestamp, safe-known-after is source delivery of the completed close, duplicates and gaps block, and any close_time > t or an open/partial t+1 bar blocks.

bootstrap_source_range.derivation: 365 daily training origins ending at first_origin minus 48h (strict target completion); B3 requires RV24_prior for earliest origin minus 29d, whose earliest return requires the close one hour before its 24-hour window.

frozen_later_implementation_contract.live_extension_rule: For origin t, acquire/materialize only required panel bars with close_time <= t into an origin-specific manifest after bootstrap history; never pre-download t+1 through t+24 target bars before the forecast artifact is authoritatively persisted.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.training_target_cutoff_rule: REFIT_EVERY_DAILY_FORECAST_ORIGIN_USING_ONLY_COMPLETED_TARGETS_STRICTLY_BEFORE_T; eligible origin o satisfies o + 24h < t. A target completing exactly at t is excluded.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.sealed_training_state: May calculate only completed target values needed for future frozen refits. It must never compute, emit, store, or expose loss, relative performance, ranking, adjusted-MSPE/HAC, p-value, classification, or rescue diagnostic during collection.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.one_origin_one_artifact: One canonical immutable artifact per (candidate_id, forecast_origin). Same origin plus same digest is an idempotent transport retry only if authoritative state proves one object/receipt; same origin plus different digest is BLOCKED_AMBIGUOUS_FORECAST_IDENTITY. No latest-wins, replacement, deletion, or post-persistence revision.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.crash_retry: Interrogate authoritative backend state after every uncertain write. Retries are allowed only before t+1h and may not recompute/persist a different artifact. Unknown remote outcome, duplicate scheduler invocation, unavailable backend, missing symbol, source outage, partial manifest, or expired window blocks the origin and the 365-origin evaluation.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.clock_contract: All timestamps are UTC-aware RFC3339; naive datetimes are rejected. Scheduler may use an operational clock only to attempt the fixed origin. The qualified backend's server-observed receipt time alone decides evidence timing. Material local/remote clock disagreement or unavailable remote time blocks evidence classification.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.scheduler_requirements: Exactly one scheduled attempt lineage per fixed origin; deterministic origin IDs; unattended invocation; retries only within the valid window; no catch-up, substitute, skip, later-start, or clock-derived today behavior; impossible origins become explicit terminal BLOCKED.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.dry_run: Required before readiness deadline using synthetic or expressly frozen historical fixtures in a TEST/NON-V1 namespace. It must exercise source interface, panel/cutoff checks, serialization/digesting, remote timestamp, idempotency, crash recovery, duplicate invocation, late/future-bar rejection, and sealed-output policy; it must never create a real V1 origin.
frozen_later_implementation_contract.network_secret_boundary: Credentials remain outside repository and logs; no auth material is serialized; endpoints are allowlisted and redirects/unrecognized endpoints fail closed; no scientific outcomes are transmitted to unrelated services.

next_action: BLOCKED: no recorder implementation or September collection is authorized. A new separately Git-backed governance phase may only reassess a specifically identified persistence backend after read-first qualification proves externally grounded non-backdateable time, artifact/origin bindings, read-after-unknown-write, and durable retention.
